resources.string: On the web console: Admin → Pair an edge remote → Create pairing code. Then type the server address and the 6 digits here, or scan the QR.
Point the camera at the QR on the web console
This QR is not a pairing code.
Paired as %1$s. Close UniGCS, then press Start.
The code is wrong, already used or expired. Ask the administrator for a new code.
Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then ask for a new code.
Cannot reach the server at %1$s. Check the Wi-Fi and the address.
The server address is not valid, e.g. http://192.168.20.13:8090
Type the 6 digits of the code.
The gateway stopped (exit code %1$d). Starting it again in %2$d s.
This remote is not paired (no gateway key). Pair it again.
Before Start: close UniGCS (Settings → Apps → UniGCS → Force stop). Only one program may use the vehicle datalink at a time.
● The gateway is not running. Press Start.
● Not connected to %1$s, retrying. Check the Wi-Fi.
● The server refused the gateway key. Ask the administrator, then pair again.
● %1$s: waiting for the first heartbeat. Is the vehicle on, and UniGCS closed?
● %1$s: no heartbeat for %2$s s. Vehicle off, out of range, or UniGCS open?
No camera to push for this remote.
● %1$s: waiting for the server\'s video address
● %1$s: ffmpeg is missing from the app
Start the gateway when the remote turns on
Off by default. Turn it on only if UniGCS is not used on this remote: the two cannot use the datalink at the same time.
Allow running with the screen off
Battery optimisation is off for this app: the gateway keeps running with the screen off.
Android may pause the gateway when the screen is off. Press the button below and choose Allow.
Forget this pairing and its gateway key? You will need a new code from the administrator.
The server has no app update yet.
Stopping the gateway before the update…
Installing: press Update on Android\'s screen. The app restarts by itself, keeps its pairing, and starts the gateway again if it was running.
Pair first: updates come from the paired server.
Cannot reach the server to update. Check the Wi-Fi, then try again.
The server refused this remote\'s key. Pair again, then update.
The downloaded file is damaged (it does not match its checksum). Try again.
The file on the server is not the 13STORE Edge app. Tell the administrator.
The file on the server is not newer than this app. Tell the administrator.

This update is signed with a different key from the installed app, so Android cannot install it over this one. The developer must build it with the original signing key (~/.13store). Otherwise: uninstall the app, install the new APK by hand, and pair again.
Allow 13STORE Edge to install apps: on the next screen turn on \"Allow from this source\", press Back, then press Update again. This is asked once.
Update cancelled. The app was not changed.
Not enough storage on the remote for the update. Free some space and try again.
Android did not install the update: %1$s
Open the app and press Start when you are ready.
